visual_logic: Frames the hyper-miniature, delicate, completely toothless pointed beak of Nemicolopterus in the wide open split framework.
prompt: High-fidelity 3D asset of the open, toothless jaws of a Nemicolopterus, viewed from a three quarter view perspective to highlight its tiny, delicate proportions, rendered in a 3D animated feature film aesthetic with soft, stylized edges. The miniature jaws form a perfectly sharp, straight needle-thin frame opened wide around a small hollow center. The margins are completely smooth and clad in a delicate, semi-translucent emerald-green keratin sheath. At the base of the tiny jaw, the stylized head features large, bright, inquisitive character eyes. Centered perfectly in a 1:1 square composition, ensuring a strict 25% negative space safety margin. Placed flat against a neutral, 50% grey studio floor plane with soft contact shadows. Illuminated by clean studio lighting to define the hyper-fine geometric tips.
